title: Example 1: Listing All Orders with Customer Details

blocks.content: Example 1: Listing All Orders with Customer Details
To list all orders, including those not linked to customers, you need to include every order from the Orders table, regardless of customer data.
For this, you can use RIGHT JOIN with the Customers table, ensuring no order is left out and missing customer details are displayed as blank.

1-- Use RIGHT JOIN to list all products from
2-- orders and show missing customer details
3-- as NULL
4
5SELECT Customers.customer_name, Customers.city, Orders.product_name
6FROM Customers
7RIGHT JOIN Orders 
8ON Customers.customer_id = Orders.customer_id;
Here, the query selects all the rows from Orders (right table) and the common rows from Customers (left table).
